scripts.text:
[High Priest]
Congratulations.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[神官]
恭喜。
向勇士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[High Priest]
Through the power
of holiness, may we
find peace, strength
and protection. Deliver
us from the forces of evil...
scripts.translation:
[神官]
愿神圣之力赐予我们
和平、力量与庇护。
请拯救我们脱离邪恶之力...

scripts.text:
[High Priest]
Our world is in
need of people of
talent and conviction.
Please continue your
good works as an even
greater hero of holiness...
scripts.translation:
[神官]
我们的世界需要
有才华且信念坚定的人。
请继续行善，
成为更伟大的神圣英雄...

scripts.text:
[High Priest]
Would you like
to become a High Priest?

[High Priest]
When you're ready,
feel free to come back.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[神官]
当您准备好了，
请随时回来。
向勇士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[High Priest]
It is still possible for you to learn more skills. Please use
all of your remaining Skill Points before returning to me.
scripts.translation:
[神官]
您仍然可以学习更多技能。请在回到我这里之前，
用完所有剩余的技能点。

scripts.text:
[High Priest]
Congratulations.
As a High Priest,
I hope you will guide
others upon the path
to holiness...
scripts.translation:
[神官]
恭喜。
作为神官，
我希望您能引导他人
走上神圣之路...

scripts.text:
[High Priest]
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[神官]
欢迎来到
英灵殿，
荣耀之厅。

scripts.text:
[High Priest]
Please make
yourself comfortable
while you are here.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[神官]
请在这里
安心休息。
向勇士们致敬！
